title: MINOR IN CATHOLIC STUDIES FOR TEACHERS Religious Studies

sections.heading: MINOR IN CATHOLIC STUDIES FOR TEACHERS
lines: NOTE: While this module offers students an excellent preparation for studies at Faculties of Education where Religious Education (as taught in Roman Catholic schools) is offered as a teachable subject, it does not guarantee admission to Western's Faculty of Education.
Completion of first-year requirements. Religious Studies 1027E is recommended.
1.0 course from: Religious Studies 2207E, Religious Studies 2234F/G, Religious Studies 2238F/G, Religious Studies 2239F/G, the former Religious Studies 2235F/G.
1.0 course from: Religious Studies 2205F/G, Religious Studies 2223E, Religious Studies 2250E, Religious Studies 3301F/G, the former Religious Studies 2217F/G.
Note: Students wishing to retain the option of upgrading to one of the other Catholic Studies Modules should use 2200 level courses to meet the requirements of the Minor Module.
Note: Students should be aware of the following course sequencing issues with respect to this module:
1) Religious Studies 2271F/G and Religious Studies 2272F/G cannot normally be taken until at least third year as they require prerequisites of Religious Studies 2201F/G and Religious Studies 2202F/G.
2) The Department of Philosophy and Religious Studies offers certain courses in alternate years; students are responsible for checking the Departmental Website for course rotation information.
